title: How outside AI clients sign in to Track3D
question: Which outside AI clients may connect to Track3D, how do users sign in from them (including users who sign in with SSO and have no password), and may a gateway page collect Track3D passwords on Track3D's behalf?
context: The MCP connector uses open client registration and a gateway-hosted email and password form, then keeps the user's Track3D refresh token encrypted (AI-REQ-015). Sign-in methods and session policy are open in DEC-011.
